coverage.in_v0: M1 split_share + gain_share for ml/served + ml/candidates LightGBM artifacts, pooled population

m2.label_note: net_long = net R of the 2 ATR / 3 ATR / 24 h long bracket after the full cost stack (the v1 / v1r20261106 label; v2 trains on a 2 / 4 bracket); fwd_ret_24h = raw 24 h log return. READ BOTH: net_long is in R, and cost in R = cost_bps / stop distance, so volatility features rank net_long through cheaper cost per R, not direction (first run 2026-11-11: atr_pct IC +0.49 vs net_long, -0.08 vs fwd_ret_24h)
m2.se_basis: rank_ic_xs: sd over timestamps / sqrt(n / 6) (overlapping 24 h labels on a 4 h step)

m2_equity.label_note: net_long = LONG net R of the registered 2 ATR stop / 3 ATR target / 24 RTH-bar bracket after fee + provisional 5 bps slippage + 0.5 bps regulatory (the ENTRY-EQ label; the struct models train a pivot-5 SL-only variant of it); fwd_ret_24 = raw 24 RTH-bar log return. Read both: net R divides by stop distance, so a volatility feature can rank net R through cost-per-R rather than direction. DEV ONLY: decisions before 2025-07-01; the confirming window is never loaded. Population: the registered POOL_RULE ETF pool (sha in this block).

m2_regime.label_note: regime_label = forward_vol > vol_threshold (a function of forward_vol alone) and trend_regime_label keys off the Kaufman efficiency ratio of the same forward window; both are measured here as the continuous quantity (forward_vol = pstdev of the next 5 1h log returns; forward_er = |sum r| / sum |r|), which carries every threshold. Features are re-derived past-only from the cached klines (vol_bucket is a monotone bucket of rolling_log_return_vol and is not listed separately). Rank IC is monotone association only.

coverage.m2_scope: rank_ic_xs (cross-sectional per 4 h decision timestamp, averaged; by quarter) and rank_ic_ts (per symbol) for the crypto decision-entry family's 20 features vs its own net-R label and the raw 24 h return
